stations.gage_quote: Water-stage recorder. Elevation of gage is 540 ft above NGVD of 1929, from topographic map. Prior to June 29, 1984, at site 400 ft downstream at same datum.

stations.gage_quote:
Water-stage recorder. Datum of gage is 226.13 ft above NAVD of 1988.  (Reference Frame NAD_83 (2011) (EPOCH:2010.0000) GEOID18). 

Prior to April 07, 2023 the datum of gage was 226.2 ft above NGVD of 1929 (levels by the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers). Prior to Nov. 1, 1938, nonrecording gage at same site and datum.

stations.gage_quote: Water-stage recorder. Datum of gage is 1,895.98 ft. above NAVD88. Satellite telemeter at station.

stations.gage_quote: Water-stage recorder (since Dec. 5, 1933) and crest-stage gage. Datum of gage is 130.52 ft above North American Vertical Datum of 1988. Prior to 3/14/2019 datum of gage was reported as 131.40 ft above National Geodetic Vertical Datum of 1929 (levels by Corps of Engineers). Apr. 4, 1904 to Dec. 31, 1905, nonrecording gage at present site and about the same datum. October 1919 to Sept. 30, 1921, and Sept. 1, 1928 to Sept. 30, 1933, water-stage recorder at site 1.5 mi downstream at different datum. Telephone telemetry at station. Satellite telemetry at station.
stations.review_rationale: 2019-03-14变更reported垂直参考，物理零点是否变化未证实，保守分段；只允许2019-10以后的目标任务，不允许跨期来源H训练。
